notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
Patch Notes - Update 1.2.1

New Features:

New Hand Model: A new hand model has been introduced for improved visual detail and gameplay immersion.

New Weapon Added: We have added a new weapon to the game, expanding the arsenal available to players.

Weapon Replacement: The Vector SMG has been replaced with the MP5, delivering a more balanced and engaging experience.

Map Changes:

Map Removal: Two maps have been removed from the game due to performance issues and instability. This should enhance game stability and reduce crashes.

Optimization:

Monster Removal: A couple of monsters have been removed to optimize the game performance. Expect smoother gameplay with less resource strain.
Script Improvements: Several scripts have been optimized, leading to better overall performance and fewer bugs.

notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
Hello Players,

We are excited to bring you the latest update, packed with new content, improvements, and features! Here are the detailed patch notes:

New Content:

New Weapons: We've added a variety of new weapons to enhance your gameplay experience. Experiment with them and find your new favorite way to take down enemies. 

New Monsters/Mutants: Encounter a host of new monsters and mutants that will challenge your skills and strategies. Each new adversary brings unique abilities and behaviors.
Optimization:

Level Design: I have tried my best to optimized the level design to ensure smoother gameplay and improved performance. Expect  bit faster load times and a more seamless experience as you navigate through the game.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Happy gaming!

Best Regards
Jacob Jufeili
Lemioutgames

notes.title: Working on new update bring new guns, and some changes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I hope you are all doing well. I am excited to announce that I am currently working on a new weapon that will be coming soon to The Nightmare of Arrival. Additionally, there will be several updates to the game. Here is what you can expect:

Map/Level Changes:
New monsters and mutants will be added,
I am also working to further optimize the game for a better experience.

Best regards,
Jacob Jufeili
Lemiout Games
